subject.title: fix(ui): turn large pasted text into compact composer attachments

question: Should Control UI automatically convert every plain-text paste over 1000 characters into a file attachment by default?
rationale: The implementation is now correct, but the unconditional threshold intentionally replaces established editable paste behavior for existing users and therefore requires product ownership.

options.title: Accept automatic conversion
options.body: Keep the 1000-character threshold with the visible restore-to-text-field action and existing focused proof.

options.title: Require explicit conversion
options.body: Preserve native paste by default and expose attachment conversion as a user-triggered action.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want a global long-paste behavior change.

recommendation.title: Accept automatic conversion
recommendation.body: Keep the 1000-character threshold with the visible restore-to-text-field action and existing focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the nearest prior paste-interception behavior and are the strongest evidence-backed owner for this default composer UX choice.
